title: BioIVT: months survived is calculated
description: Makes 'Number of months survived' a read-only calculation: whole months from the diagnosis date to the date of death (from Death Details when one exists), otherwise to the date follow-up data was provided, i.e. survived so far. Blank when a needed date is missing.
rationale: Dan asked for a proposal from the study design. Uses the Death Details form built in Phase 1.

set.field.calculation: if(${DIAGDT}='' or if(${DTHDAT_CF}!='', ${DTHDAT_CF}, ${DTFUPROV})='', '', if(decimal-date-time(if(${DTHDAT_CF}!='', ${DTHDAT_CF}, ${DTFUPROV})) < decimal-date-time(${DIAGDT}), '', int((decimal-date-time(if(${DTHDAT_CF}!='', ${DTHDAT_CF}, ${DTFUPROV})) - decimal-date-time(${DIAGDT})) div 30.4375)))

source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
